description: This source file defines the Analytics object responsible for logging various user actions and events within the application, such as calendar views, astrology views, leave additions, backups, and error reporting, utilizing Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics.

classes.name: Analytics
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to initialize Firebase analytics and log specific user interactions and app events.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Firebase Analytics instance with the application context.

methods.name: logCalendarView
methods.description: Logs a screen view event for the calendar fragment with the specified date.

methods.name: logLeaveAdded
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a leave of a certain type has been added.

methods.name: logAstrologyView
methods.description: Logs an event when the astrology view is accessed, with the specified date.

methods.name: logBackupCreated
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a backup was created.

methods.name: logBackupRestored
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a backup was restored.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Records an exception to Crashlytics for error tracking.
